note: What a muzzle flash must show on the screen (1280x720, shoulder camera), from the probe's rows. Held by tests/captures/flash_probe.gd (desktop, 60 fps), tools/web_smoke/flash.py (browser) and tests/weapons/test_muzzle_flash_strength.gd. Set about two thirds under the worst weapon measured after the rework, and far over the worst before it (docs/research/muzzle-flash.md); `web` lowers the floors the browser run is held to. screen_gain is how much the whole picture brightens, of 255.

web.note: The browser's first view looks down on the soldier, so the flash is smaller in the picture: the floors it is held to.
